title: Leader
desc: Vijay is a rebellious law student who boldly criticises the government, flirts with a beautiful woman and invites trouble. But his life changes when he is accused of assassinating a politician.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Yare Nee Abhimani
desc: Adithya, a writer, falls for Utthara after reading her letter but mistakenly believes Prajna is Utthara when they meet, leading him to propose to her, which sparks a complicated love triangle.

title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
